About VISHVAM

Knowledge. Vision. Wisdom.

Main Shivam Anand Jha, VISHVAM ke madhyam se Jyotish ke gyaan aur analysis ko saral aur samajhne layak roop mein prastut karne ka prayas karta hoon.

Mera focus keval prediction tak seemit nahi hai. Kundli ke vibhinna factors ko samajhkar vyakti ko apni paristhitiyon aur possibilities ko ek naye perspective se dekhne mein guidance dena VISHVAM ka uddeshya hai.
